seoTitle: Glee Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Glee test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Rachel, Kurt, Finn, Santana, Brittany, Quinn, Puck or Sue — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the star, the queen of comebacks, or the villain with a megaphone? Answer 12 everyday questions about ambition, friendship and standing out, and find out which Glee character you are.

characters.name: Rachel Berry
characters.title: The Star
characters.summary: Driven, dramatic and incredibly talented. You know exactly what you want, and you'll work harder than anyone to get it.
description: Like Rachel, you've always known you were meant for more. She's the most driven member of the glee club, and often misunderstood by everyone else.
You never stop working. Rachel is talented and ambitious, and she's been preparing for stardom her whole life.
You make it. Rachel becomes a Broadway star in Funny Girl, and goes on to win a Tony.
characters.flaw: You can be so focused on your dream that you forget other people have them too.
characters.signature: A gold star sticker, an argyle sweater and a solo you've already rehearsed.
characters.clashReason: they'd make every moment about their big solo

characters.name: Kurt Hummel
characters.title: The Fabulous One
characters.summary: Witty, stylish and braver than anyone knows. You look fearless, even when you're terrified inside.
description: Like Kurt, you have impeccable taste. He's been described as 'a tough guy in designer clothes'.
You're braver than you look. Kurt faces bullying at school with a confident front, even though he's anxious underneath.
You find your happy ending. Kurt marries Blaine, and years later they're working actors who teach acceptance in schools.
characters.flaw: You can be a little bit of a snob, and you know it.
characters.signature: A perfectly tailored outfit, a raised eyebrow and a high note nobody else can hit.
characters.clashReason: they'd judge your outfit before they said hello

characters.name: Finn Hudson
characters.title: The Big-Hearted Leader
characters.summary: Warm, goofy and loyal. You're not always sure what you're doing, but your heart is always in the right place.
description: Like Finn, you're the nice guy everyone likes. He's the school's popular quarterback.
You risk it all for what you love. Finn joins the glee club, even though it could cost him his popularity.
You lead with your heart. Finn is warm, often conflicted, and he means the world to the people around him.
characters.flaw: You can't make up your mind, and you hate letting anyone down.
characters.signature: A letterman jacket, a goofy grin and two left feet.
characters.clashReason: they'd never be able to make up their mind

characters.name: Santana Lopez
characters.title: The Queen of Comebacks
characters.summary: Sharp, savage and fiercely protective of the few people you let in.
description: Like Santana, you've got a comeback for everything. She's a cheerleader with the sharpest tongue at McKinley.
You keep your guard up. Santana is a bit of a bad girl, and she rarely lets anyone see what she's really feeling.
But you love fiercely. Santana's loyalty to Brittany never wavers, and the two of them end up married.
characters.flaw: You'd rather insult someone than admit you care about them.
characters.signature: A cheerleading uniform, a razor-sharp comeback and a soft spot for one person.
characters.clashReason: they'd roast you in front of everyone

characters.name: Brittany Pierce
characters.title: The Free Spirit
characters.summary: Sweet, surprising and completely unique. You see the world in a way nobody else does.
description: Like Brittany, you're one of a kind. She's a cheerleader with an unpredictable, often wonderfully nonsensical way of seeing the world.
You're smarter than people think. Brittany finds out her biological father is Stephen Hawking.
You love openly. Brittany marries Santana, and even convinces Kurt and Blaine to make it a double wedding.
characters.flaw: You drift off into your own world, sometimes at the worst possible moment.
characters.signature: A cat with a lot of opinions, a killer dance move and a thought nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd change the subject to something completely random mid-argument

characters.name: Quinn Fabray
characters.title: The Perfectionist
characters.summary: Polished, ambitious and more complicated than you look. You want to be perfect, and it's exhausting.
description: Like Quinn, you know how to look like you've got it all together. She's the head cheerleader, and popularity matters to her.
But you want more than that. Quinn is torn between wanting to be popular and wanting to be truly accepted.
You come back stronger. Quinn gives up her daughter, Beth, gets into Yale and recovers from a serious injury.
characters.flaw: You care so much about what people think that you lose track of what you think.
characters.signature: A perfect smile, a Yale acceptance letter and a past you'd rather not talk about.
characters.clashReason: they'd care more about how things look than how they feel

characters.name: Noah Puckerman
characters.title: The Bad Boy
characters.summary: Cocky, rebellious and a lot softer than you look. You break the rules, but you show up when it counts.
description: Like Puck, you like to break the rules. He's Finn's best friend, a former bully with a famous mohawk.
You're softer than you seem. Puck becomes a father to Beth, and it changes him.
You get there in the end. After a rocky few years, Puck graduates and gets back together with Quinn.
characters.flaw: You act tough so nobody sees how much you care.
characters.signature: A mohawk, a guitar and a smirk.
characters.clashReason: they'd break every rule you care about, just for fun

characters.name: Sue Sylvester
characters.title: The Villain
characters.summary: Ruthless, scheming and hilariously savage. You don't do second place, and you definitely don't do nice.
description: Like Sue, you play to win. She's the ruthless cheerleading coach and the glee club's biggest rival.
You've got an insult for everyone. Sue's sharp, scheming personality makes her one of the show's most memorable characters.
You aim high. By the series finale, Sue has become Vice-President of the United States.
characters.flaw: You'd rather destroy the competition than share the spotlight.
characters.signature: A tracksuit, a megaphone and a plan to ruin someone's day.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to destroy you, just because you were in the way

questions.text: Your school is putting on a big show. You...

options.text: Demand the solo. You've been preparing since you were four
Design the costumes. They'll be fabulous
Volunteer, then remember you can't dance
Sabotage it. Then deny everything
Hit back with a comeback they'll hear in their sleep
Raise an eyebrow. Clearly, they know nothing about fashion
Thank them. You thought they were complimenting your shoes
Shrug. You look good, and you know it

questions.text: You've got a free afternoon. You...

options.text: Have a long, serious chat with your cat
Rehearse. Talent doesn't practise itself
Skip whatever you were meant to be doing and have some fun
Work on becoming the best version of yourself

questions.text: Someone new joins your group, and they're better than you at the thing you love. You...

options.text: Panic, then challenge them to a sing-off
Make sure they know their place
Welcome them. More talent is good for everyone
Smile sweetly, then quietly compete

questions.text: You make a really embarrassing mistake in public. You...

options.text: Laugh at yourself. It happens a lot
Hold your head high. Confidence fixes everything
Insist you did it on purpose, and that it was genius
Don't notice. Wait, was it a mistake?

questions.text: You're up against your biggest rivals. You...

options.text: Win at any cost. Rules are for losers
Give the performance of your life
Trash-talk them, then actually show up for your team
Psych them out before it even starts

questions.text: Someone you love is being bullied. You...

options.text: Have a word with the bully. A firm one
Stand up to them, even though you're terrified
Get the whole group to stand with them
Pull some strings behind the scenes to make it stop

questions.text: Your love life gets complicated. You...

options.text: Pick whoever looks best on paper, then regret it
Turn it into a song
Pretend you don't care, while caring a lot
Tell everyone exactly how you feel, very sweetly

questions.text: Someone gives you advice you didn't ask for. You...

options.text: Tell them you don't take advice from people with their haircut
Smile politely, then do it your way
Actually listen. They might be right
Ignore it completely

questions.text: Your big dream suddenly seems out of reach. You...

options.text: Never give up. You've wanted this your whole life
Reinvent yourself completely, and start again
Pick a new dream. You've got lots
Bully the universe until it gives in

questions.text: You're in a high school glee club, and the rest of the school thinks you're all losers. You...

options.text: Stay, even if it costs you your popularity
Act like you're above it, then sing your heart out anyway
Wear it like a badge of honour
Admit you only joined for a girl, then stay for the music

questions.text: The glee club keeps stealing the spotlight from your cheerleading squad. You...

options.text: Declare war
Join them as a spy, then accidentally start to like them
Cheer for both. You like singing and dancing
Mock them relentlessly, while secretly wanting a solo
